title.value: Run 135 smart home and errand tasks through Alexa+

introduction.value: David Pogue gave Alexa+ on an Echo Show 11 135 tasks with connected devices and accounts like Uber and Grubhub; it got about half right and often gave bad information.

method.value: Pogue tested a loaned 11-inch Echo Show. He linked Ecobee thermostats, Ring doorbells, Sonos speakers, a Sony TV, and Uber, Grubhub and Spotify accounts. He built the tasks largely from Amazon's "50+ things to try" list and filmed the session. He changed the wake word to "Ziggy". When music failed, he spent hours troubleshooting and re-added his Spotify credentials.

outcome.value: About half of the 135 tasks worked. Calendar changes, Uber rides and general questions did well. Ring, Ecobee control, playlists, videos, shopping and several advertised features failed, and Alexa+ often hallucinated instead of explaining why.

notes.value: A wrong account setup, such as Alexa+ treating his Spotify account as free, caused silent failures. He needed hours to diagnose it, because Alexa+ never explained the cause.

source_text.body:
Run 135 smart home and errand tasks through Alexa+
David Pogue gave Alexa+ on an Echo Show 11 135 tasks with connected devices and accounts like Uber and Grubhub; it got about half right and often gave bad information.
Done with
A+
Alexa+
What they did
Pogue tested a loaned 11-inch Echo Show. He linked Ecobee thermostats, Ring doorbells, Sonos speakers, a Sony TV, and Uber, Grubhub and Spotify accounts. He built the tasks largely from Amazon's "50+ things to try" list and filmed the session. He changed the wake word to "Ziggy". When music failed, he spent hours troubleshooting and re-added his Spotify credentials.
How it went
About half of the 135 tasks worked. Calendar changes, Uber rides and general questions did well. Ring, Ecobee control, playlists, videos, shopping and several advertised features failed, and Alexa+ often hallucinated instead of explaining why.
Worth knowing
A wrong account setup, such as Alexa+ treating his Spotify account as free, caused silent failures. He needed hours to diagnose it, because Alexa+ never explained the cause.
Try it yourself
with
Alexa+
Copy prompt
Alexa, I want to test you on everyday tasks. Let's go through these one at a time: [list of smart home commands, e.g. dim the living room lights to 30 percent], [errand request, e.g. check my Grubhub order status], and [question needing current info]. After each, tell me what you did and how sure you are. Before any purchase or order, pause and confirm the details with me.
Original source: https://pogueman.substack.com/p/alexa-is-a-buggy-embarrassment
